visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a shot of a street-side restaurant storefront featuring a prominent green sign with white and red Chinese characters. A white banner below it displays a phone number. (2) Inside the shop, an elderly man wearing a light blue polo shirt and purple nitrile gloves smiles warmly at someone off-camera. He is standing behind a stainless steel food preparation counter. (3) A close-up shows a hand in a purple glove using a black marker to write Chinese characters and numbers on a white notepad. (4) The scene shifts to several plates of food on a table: a platter of sliced duck with ginger, a bowl of soup, and a bowl of noodles. (5) Back at the counter, the elderly man uses a large cleaver to expertly slice cooked duck on a wooden cutting board. (6) A metal ladle pours clear, steaming broth over a plate of sliced duck, which is then topped with shredded ginger and green onions. (7) Chopsticks lift a piece of the duck, showing its pinkish meat and yellowish skin, which is then dipped into a small bowl of red sauce. (8) Close-ups follow of duck blood cake topped with ginger, bean sprouts mixed with intestines, and a large bowl of translucent vermicelli being lifted. (9) A close-up of thin, wavy noodles being tossed in a dark sauce with duck slices. (10) The final shot shows the busy interior of the restaurant with several customers seated at tables, followed by a text overlay with the shop's address and the logo of the creators.
